sources.entry: Latest - A tiny app that checks if all your apps from any source are up to date. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/mangerlahn/Latest)
Latest - Small utility app for macOS that makes sure you know about all the latest updates to the apps you use.

summary.one_liner: Latest is a small free, open-source macOS utility that checks whether your installed apps are up to date and shows what changed.
summary.what_it_does: Latest scans the apps on a Mac and reports which ones have updates available. It currently supports apps downloaded from the Mac App Store and apps that use the Sparkle update framework. It gives a quick overview of which apps changed and what changed, and lets you update them from the app. The README describes it as a tiny utility app. The project is developed in the author's spare time, with planned work tracked in the Issues section.
use_cases: check which Mac apps have updates
see what changed in app updates
track Mac App Store and Sparkle app versions
keep all Mac apps up to date from one place
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the Releases page, unzip it, and move Latest.app into the Applications folder.
Install via Homebrew Cask: brew install --cask latest
Build from source: git clone --recurse-submodules git@github.com:mangerlahn/Latest.git
Open Latest.xcodeproj in Xcode, select the Latest scheme, and hit Build and Run.
stack: Sparkle (update framework supported by the app)
notable: Checks apps from the Mac App Store and Sparkle-based apps for updates
Shows what changed in each update before you install it
Available as a direct app download, via Homebrew Cask, or built from source
Text translations are managed through Weblate
caveats: Only supports Mac App Store apps and apps that use Sparkle for updates, per the README
Developed in the author's free time, so updates may be occasional
Building from source requires Xcode 11 and Swift 5
